## Report (req_2651 — painted ground invisible, silent WGSL compile failure)

### Changes

**cart/editor/render3d/groundFormula.ts:84-104** — `composedFillFuncs()` now appends `.replace(/\bU\.time\b/g, 'S.time')` to the compose-time rewrites, with a comment explaining the fills are authored for the Effect pipeline (uniform `U`) while the ground pipeline exposes the same wrapped wall-clock as `S.time`. Nothing under `shaders/_generated/` was touched.

**framework/gpu/shaders.zig:757 and :1581** — the two SceneUniforms WGSL declarations still naming the offset-124 slot `_pad3` (main scene3d shader, ground prefix) now declare `time: f32` with a comment. Byte layout unchanged.

**framework/gpu/3d.zig:5901-5911 and :5960-5964** — `ensureGroundPipeline` failures are now loud: bufPrint overflow, `createShaderModule` null, and `createRenderPipeline` null each `std.debug.print` an `[r3d-ground] ERROR` naming the formula hash and stating ALL painted ground is INVISIBLE until fixed.

### Deviation from the task spec (deliberate, flagged)
The task said rename `_pad4b` (offset 156) to `time` and add a per-frame time write in 3d.zig. **Both were already half-done by prior work**: the Zig `SceneUniforms` struct already has `time: f32` at offset 124 (former `_pad3`, 3d.zig:55) and it is already populated every frame with the wrapped wall-clock (3d.zig:6388/6404 — the same clock grass wind and water use, `S.time` in grass/water/frond WGSL). Renaming `_pad4b` would have created a *second*, never-populated time slot diverging from the live one. I instead renamed `_pad3` → `time` in the two remaining WGSL declarations, which achieves the exact intent (real animated `S.time` visible to the ground formula) with zero layout change and no struct divergence. No new time-write code was needed in 3d.zig.

Not my code, not touched by me; it resolved itself and the third run compiled clean.
